title: tehas history --json
description: What tehas history --json prints, version 1: the runs that ended, cycles and planning turns, oldest first. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. One items schema covers both kinds of line, so a field only one kind prints is optional here: `kind` says which line a field belongs to, and a line leaves out what it lacks, never printing it null. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the samples beside this file against it and what the command prints.

cycle.description: The cycle id, <issue>-<attempt>, on a work line: a running cycle in tehas status has the same. Unique within one store (store in tehas api). With the feature cycle-ids.

started.description: When it started. Always on a work line: one the store holds no start for started when it ended.

end.description: The word a program decides on, on a work line, from a closed set: tehas_core::outcome::end of the line's outcome, status, change, parked and failureKind. With the feature cycle-ids.

progress.description: Where the step a cycle ended in was, as its driver reported it. Driver-specific and may change in a minor release: a program shows it, and does not decide on it. Left out when nothing of it is known.

change.description: The number of the change the work line names, on a line that names one; pr is its address. With the feature cycle-ids.

recorded.description: When a work line was written, on a line written after its end: a lost cycle's, whose ended is when it was last heard from.

signalled.description: true on a work line when a signal stopped the cycle; left out otherwise.
